title: Normalized category definition (legacy categories domain)
description: Contract for one normalized shop-taxonomy category: one stored legacy categories object entry. The stored object key is the stable identity, so legacy_id is the key verbatim (rule N2); integer ids and localized names are kept verbatim with the sub array carried as observed (rule N3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored categories object key preserved verbatim (rule N2).

kind.description: Classification of the stored categories domain: every entry maps to category.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets categories).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets categories).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native stored category id, kept verbatim (rule N3).

name.description: Category display name, preserved verbatim (rule N3).

sub.description: Subcategory entries carried as observed integer-id/name/parent triples; each parent equals the category id (rule N3).
